verdict.rationale: Flagsmith lets you control where data lives by self-hosting the whole platform in your own infrastructure, including via Docker, with "full control over your data." The self-hosted Edge Proxy can also run close to your servers. However, nothing in the evidence shows a region or residency choice (e.g., EU vs US) within the hosted SaaS, so residency control depends on running it yourself. Missing for 10: hosted-SaaS region selection, documented data-residency guarantees, independent corroboration.
